prompt:
A student answered a question about a short Java program. Decide which concepts each clause of the answer talks about.

Program:
System.out.print("A");
if (x % 2 == 0) {
  System.out.print("B");
  if (x % 5 == 2) { System.out.print("C"); } else { System.out.print("D"); }
} else {
  if (x % 5 == 2) { System.out.print("E"); } else { System.out.print("F"); }
  System.out.print("G");
}

Question: What is printed when x = 17? Explain.

Student's answer, split into clauses:
c1: So first Java looks at the code and the first thing it does is print A, which always happens no matter what x is, and then it checks whether x is even, and 17 is not even
c2: because 17 divided by 2 leaves 1
c3: so it skips the whole first part with B, C and D, and goes to the else part, where it checks 17 % 5, which is 2
c4: so it prints E, and then after that inner if-else it prints G
c5: so overall I think the answer would be AEG, which makes sense
c6: because…
